name: Premium Wireless Earbuds Pro
description:
Experience crystal-clear audio with our Premium Wireless Earbuds Pro. Featuring active noise cancellation, 36-hour battery life, and IPX5 water resistance — perfect for workouts, commuting, and everyday use.

**Key Highlights:**
- Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) blocks up to 95% of ambient noise
- Bluetooth 5.3 with ultra-low latency for gaming and calls
- Ergonomic design with 3 sizes of silicone tips for all-day comfort
- Touch controls for music, calls, and voice assistant
- USB-C fast charging: 10 min charge = 3 hours playback
deliveryInfo: Delivery in 2-3 working days across Pakistan
